vedic_reference.note: Sadanand is a name of Lord Vishnu in Hinduism. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sada', which means 'eternal' and 'anand', which means 'bliss'. This name signifies that Lord Vishnu is the eternal source of bliss and happiness.
